name: Officers College of the PAP
zh: 中国人民武装警察部队警官学院

evidence.summary: The PAP Officers College in Shuangliu, south of Chengdu, is a People’s Armed Police academy: NDU’s study of the PAP and CASI’s translation of the PLA’s 2024 recruitment plan both list it among the force’s academies. Its own 2015 profile says it trains junior commanders for the PAP’s internal security, mobile and specialised forces, and that its cadets took part in security duties in Tibetan areas after the March 2008 unrest and in earthquake relief.

The college says it took its present name in 2011 and was placed directly under PAP headquarters; NDU notes that reforms in 2017–2018 put the PAP under the sole authority of the Central Military Commission.
